title: Mark Antony (2000 film)
text:
Mark Antony is a 2000 Indian Malayalam action film, directed by T. S. Suresh Babu and produced by Safeel and Minraj. Story by Shaji T Nedumkallel and screenplay and dialogue By Kaloor Dennis. The film stars Suresh Gopi, Divya Unni, Janardanan and Lalu Alex in lead roles. The film had musical score by Berny-Ignatius.

Suresh Gopi as Parel Antony aka Mark Anthony

Janardanan as Parel Pappu Chathu, Antony's father

Divya Unni as Mambally Nimmy, Antony's love intrest

Lalu Alex as Fr. Parel Urumees

N. F. Varghese as Mullakka

K. P. A. C. Lalitha as Kunjoutha, Antony's mother & Pappu's wife

Madhupal as Parel Pappachan, Antony's youngest brother

Baiju as Parel Kariyachan, Antony's Younger brother

Kaveri as Kunjipennu/Reeja, Pappu's daughter and Antony's younger sister

Adoor Bhavani as Kunjeli

Indrans as Isaac, Antony's aide

VK Sreeraman as Mambally Chakkappan

Bheeman Raghu as Mambally Kuriachen
